tasks.title: Scaffold the mdBook and its pages
tasks.description: Add docs/book.toml, docs/src/SUMMARY.md, docs/src/introduction.md, and docs/src/upgrading.md. No remote theme or asset; the summary exposes every page from the landing page.

tasks.title: Implement the matrix and crate-index generator
tasks.description: Add scripts/docs-matrix.js: read catalogue/00_provider_index.md and each crate manifest, write docs/src/crates.md and docs/src/provider-matrix.md deterministically, and support --check to fail when the generated text differs from disk.

tasks.title: Implement the error-reference generator
tasks.description: Add scripts/docs-errors.js: scan the crates' error enums for documented stable codes and generate docs/src/errors.md, supporting --check.

tasks.title: Implement the drift and link checker
tasks.description: Add scripts/docs-check.js: run both generators in check mode and validate every relative link in docs/src, failing on a broken link or an http:// external link.

tasks.title: Wire the docs job into CI
tasks.description: Add a docs job to .github/workflows/ci.yml: install a pinned mdBook (prebuilt, cached), run mdbook build docs, then node scripts/docs-check.js. The job fails if either step fails.

tasks.title: Link the site from the README and document the upgrade policy
tasks.description: Add the docs-site link to the README and finish docs/src/upgrading.md with the 0.x-to-1.0 policy and where breaking changes will be recorded.

tasks.title: Run the verification checks
tasks.description: Run mdbook build docs, node scripts/docs-check.js, node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js, and cargo fmt --all --check to confirm the repository baseline is untouched.
